notes.title: Huge content update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42882469/ff2bf33997f282ebfffd2100d40d795b3b82403e.jpg[/img]

Now weighing in at over 13000 lines of dialogue from 30000 lines of code, this has become a very complicated, and varied game, despite still being quite short. This update includes a very graphical updates, as well as the whole next segment, and victim giving you twice as much information before having to choose your suspect.

We are also launching the Boardgame, which is a reverse murderer mystery!
You can find more about that in-game.

notes.title: Week 1 release bug fixing
notes.notes:
You can now be murdered!
*Crowd cheers*

After your feedback on the steam update notes, we've fixed some parts of the game:

-You can now be murdered
-Additional dialogue that existed already but was hidden for the same reason you couldn't be murdered, now exists. (You basically announce who you were with for the hour)
-The wager screen update was implemented in reverse. All people now start as marked dead and you select which ones you think will live.


And so now, we have a more stable build live on steam! :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42882469/94a8c1986a1f53cd605f72f1298daa2b24bf5eca.jpg[/img]
